messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game inspired by Poppy Playtime Chapter 1.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built an original browser-based toy-factory horror game titled “Playtime: The Last Shift,” with original visuals and a GrabGlove, power-cell, and escape objective loop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable canvas game with title screen, movement, interaction, GrabGlove aiming, collectible cells, power panel, chasing enemy, escape goal, pause/restart screens, and mobile controls.
- Added responsive UI and factory visuals in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Ran `node --check game.js`; it passed.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002`; browser loaded and gameplay HUD rendered.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/title.jpg`, `screenshots/game.jpg`, and `screenshots/game2.jpg`; last screenshot was inspected.

### Active
- Improve and verify gameplay visuals/interactions; the latest screenshot showed the game screen, and lighting was adjusted afterward.
- Confirm the GrabGlove pickup and full objective sequence work correctly.

### Blocked
- Browser console reported one 404 for `/favicon.ico`; no gameplay errors were observed.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current game screenshot after the lighting adjustments, capturing a fresh JPEG if needed.
2. Test movement, glove pickup, cell collection, panel activation, enemy chase, and exit flow in the browser.
3. Fix any discovered interaction or visual issues and briefly summarize assumptions at completion.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screen structure and overlays.
- `style.css`: Title screen, HUD, responsive layouts, and mobile controls.
- `game.js`: Game logic, canvas rendering, objectives, and controls.
- `screenshots/game2.jpg`: Latest inspected gameplay screenshot.
- `screenshots/title.jpg`: Title screen screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `playwright-cli` works after installing Chromium; browser session is open at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli run-code "await page.keyboard.down('d'); ..."` failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'page'`; use individual CLI keyboard commands or valid Playwright code syntax.
